Fortin Amplification browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Fortin Amplification Kali - Pre-Amp / Distortion Published on August 8, 2025 Fortin Amplification boost / preamp distortion pedal Information The Fortin KALI is a preamp and distortion pedal that channels the aggressive tone and precision of the Fortin CALI amplifier into a compact, pedalboard-friendly format. As the third entry in Fortin's preamp series, following the NATAS and MESHUGGAH, KALI delivers the same cutting-edge sound design that has defined the brand's modern high-gain reputation. KALI operates as both a standalone distortion pedal and a full-featured preamp, offering two gain channels and a wide array of tonal controls. Channel 1 provides the foundation, while Channel 2 adds an additional cascaded gain stage for more saturation and harmonic content. Each gain control features its own three-position Bright switch, letting players tailor high-frequency response to match vintage Plexi-style sparkle or the biting clarity of modded British tones. The Gain 2 knob governs the primary gain for both channels, while Gain 1 becomes active only on Channel 2, enabling a more saturated and dynamic sound. A Master knob sets the output volume and interacts directly with the pedal's voicing mode selector. This three-way switch toggles between VINT (vintage voicing with added compression and brightness), RAW (unfiltered and direct), and SAT (Fortin's signature saturation with touch-sensitive compression). An active three-band EQ section-Bass, Mid, and Treble-provides studio-grade shaping, allowing players to refine their sound for any rig or musical context. Designed to pair directly with power amps, FX returns, or traditional amp inputs, the KALI adapts easily to a variety of setups without sacrificing fidelity. KALI is constructed in the USA using high-grade components and features relay-based true bypass switching for consistent reliability. Its design reflects Mike Fortin's legacy in amp modification, honoring the lineage of Jose Arredondo's pioneering work while pushing forward with modern functionality.
